title: Telemetry Healthgate: Terraform module for VPC observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, log shippers)
creator: Irene Nakamura
description: Create a reusable Terraform module (telemetry_healthgate) that provisions and manages the full observability stack for Private (VPC) deployments: Prometheus operator + metrics ingestion, Grafana (dashboards + provisioning), OpenTelemetry Collector (OTel) as the central metrics/traces/logs aggregator, and log shipping agents (Fluent Bit or Vector) to cloud storage or log-forwarder endpoints. The module must be production-ready for upgrades and include preflight/health checks, upgrade hooks, and a canary rollout pattern for chart/operator upgrades. It should be configurable for cloud-specific resources (VPC endpoints, S3/GCS buckets, IAM roles) and support both helm_release and k8s manifest install paths.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes clear inputs/outputs and example root module for Redwood Private deployments
Can create a new observability stack in a test VPC using the module with required inputs documented
Automated canary deployment: new chart/operator version can be deployed to 1/10 nodes and validated via health probes before full rollout
Health check endpoints and synthetic probes exist: /health for OTel, Prometheus exporter health, Fluent Bit liveness/readiness
Upgrade hooks migrate PVCs and preserve dashboards/configs; rollbacks restore prior state without manual DB edits
Terratest and integration CI run validate module idempotency, destroy, and version skew scenarios
Security controls available: optional KMS-encrypted secrets, IAM role mapping, and audit log forwarding enabled
implementation_notes: Design decisions and trade-offs: prefer Helm for Grafana and Prometheus operator to leverage ecosystem but provide a manifest path for air-gapped customers. Use Kubernetes StatefulSets for Prometheus with PVC lifecycle hooks to allow safe upgrades; store long-term metrics in remote_write if configured. OTel Collector runs as a Deployment with hot-config reload via config map hash and a sidecar shipper when necessary. Log shipping defaults to Fluent Bit (small resource footprint) with an option for Vector where binary-level performance is needed.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge module PR to infra/terraform-modules with feature-flagged root example. 2) Deploy to sandbox VPC and run full e2e tests. 3) Canary upgrade to 10% of clusters (selected sentinel cells) and monitor SLOs for 48h. 4) Ramp to 50% if no regressions, then 100% with rolling upgrade. 5) If errors exceed thresholds, automatic rollback via terraform apply using previous module version tag. 6) Post-upgrade smoke run and runbook checklist completion.
testing_plan: Unit: tfsec + checkov static checks, terraform validate/plan. Integration: Terratest suite boots a small k3s cluster, deploys module, verifies endpoints, writes synthetic metrics and logs, asserts retention/forwarding. Chaos tests: simulate node termination and verify PVC re-attach and Prometheus scrape continuity. Upgrade tests: apply minor and major version upgrades for Helm charts and ensure no data loss and dashboards persist.
